title: Clay’s New AI Agent Could Change How We Build GTM Systems
blurb: The agent plans, tests and builds plays across Clay’s products from a chat request. Clay says 3.2% of companies had a GTM engineer on payroll in September. You might not need a GTM engineer to build your next outbound workflow.

title: AI for Growth Marketing: How To Use Claude, ChatGPT, Clay, and Apollo
blurb: Key takeaways The growth stack has settled into three layers: data (Apollo, Clay), reasoning (Claude, ChatGPT), and delivery (your sequencer and CRM). The teams pulling ahead connect the layers instead of copy-pasting between them.
